name: Niregane Moeka
source:
"The Protagonist's Older Sister"

A responsible older sister who also possesses a feminine side. She attends a different school than the protagonist and is a diligent, top student.

She lived apart from the protagonist for a while. She is very caring and always looks out for the protagonist. True to her status as a top student, she has a strong sense of justice.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha05.html]official site[/url]]
